reaction: It is satisfying to see the crop produce something after surviving the storm.

expectation: I expect to wash and cook the potatoes for a meal, though I don't know exactly how they will be served.

reaction: The meal feels like a satisfying payoff for the crop, with the radio hiss adding a quiet note.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting the potatoes was most worthwhile: seeing the crop after it survived the storm made the earlier care feel consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Neither action felt especially confusing or repetitive, though taking the potatoes to the galley was predictable.

surprise.text: The potatoes were larger than the seed pieces brought from Earth; I hadn't known what the harvest would look like.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the basket served the harvest and the galley served the meal.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens with the discovery and the return journey; this chapter provided a quiet payoff but left me curious.
